newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Postal Union suspends mail to Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: Postal Union suspends mail to Sierra Leone.

text.p: Mail services to and from Sierra Leone have been suspended by the Universal Postal Union (UPU), which oversees global postal business, Sierra Leone mail officials said on Friday.

"Universal Postal Union wrote a letter dated August 11 to the Sierra Leone postal services, Salpost, suspending it. The letter said Sierra Leone will remain suspended until the country is restored to democracy, which will bring an atmosphere of greater public security and stability," an official said.
Air mail is already effectively stopped because airlines suspended flights to Sierra Leone after a military coup in May.

Sierra Leone's West African neighbours are putting pressure on the ruling junta to restore democratic rule. There have been renewed clashes between junta forces and West African ECOMOG soldiers in recent days following the breakdown of talks.
